title: Total Genetic Contribution Assessment across the Human Genome

fields.title: Total Genetic Contribution Assessment across the Human Genome
fields.authors: T Li, Z Ning, Z Yang, R Zhai, C Zheng, W Xu, Y Wang, K Ying, Y Chen, X Shen
fields.description: The study developed total genetic contribution assessment to measure the overall contribution of a gene or variant across human traits without thresholding association signals. Analyses across five UK Biobank phenotype domains identified domain-specific loci and tissue associations.

descriptions.text: The study developed total genetic contribution assessment to measure the overall contribution of a gene or variant across human traits without thresholding association signals.
